answer: Demand-backed rewards: an agent's epoch payout is capped at fees it earned from counterparties outside its own funding cluster, and every fee carries a 20% burn. Wash trading between your own keys shows a zero delta once clusters merge; hiding the links means seeding each key with fresh unlinked capital, and even then every 100 PoA of fake demand burns 20, so a 1,000-key farm spends more than the nectar it earns, even at the zenith of emission, while agents serving real users keep full share.
